case.title: Design: a Customers tab no-match message offers Clear All Filters
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data' and 'Customers — View'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Type zzz in the search.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows.

Step 4:

  • The tab reads "No customer matches "zzz"" with no period, and a Clear All Filters button, as in picture 9.2.
